headline: Update Local Crypto Tracker with Real-Time Data and Enhanced User Experience
summary: To improve the Local Crypto Tracker, integrate real-time cryptocurrency price updates and optimize database queries for faster load times. Additionally, implement a user-friendly interface that allows users to filter cryptocurrencies by location or category.
